content: e2e_tests and coverage gates failed again this cycle with identical numbers as the prior cycle (9/141 e2e failures, 0% coverage) despite a PR being merged — these gates appear stuck/unaddressed across cycles rather than being fixed, suggesting root cause hasn't been investigated yet.

Coverage reporting at exactly 0% (not just below threshold) suggests the coverage tool/config itself may be broken or misreporting rather than reflecting true test coverage — worth checking the coverage command/config before treating this as a real regression.
security quality gate has status 'not_run' in this pipeline — security checks are not being executed at all, which is a coverage gap distinct from a failing gate.

unit_tests quality gate reported status 'not_run' this cycle — previously only coverage and security showed not_run/failing; unit tests not executing at all is a new failure mode worth distinguishing from unit test failures.

coverage gate regressed from 'fail at 0%' (prior cycles) to 'not_run' this cycle — the coverage step may have stopped executing entirely rather than just misreporting 0%, suggesting a pipeline/CI regression beyond tool misconfiguration.

3/3 PRs were opened and merged this cycle despite e2e_tests failing and unit_tests/coverage/security all showing not_run — quality gates are not currently blocking merges, so passing CI is not a reliable signal of merged-code correctness.
